summary.text: Rustin Provance, an independent who described himself in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey as a Certified Nursing Assistant, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Wisconsin's 3rd District to Rebecca Cooke.
In that survey he said he opposes taxation he calls illegal and supports term limits.
Little other biographical information is public.

paragraphs.text: Provance was born in Cameron, Missouri, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia records him as an independent candidate for this seat in 2022 and 2024 who withdrew before the general election each time; he was on the ballot in 2026.
He received 0.5% of the vote to Rebecca Cooke's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
